reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-scott-colom-interview-praise-b3084510.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump praised Mississippi's Senator-elect Scott Colom following his historic senate upset.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/historically-red-mississippi-and-alaska-win-blue-senate-seats) reported that historically red Mississippi and Alaska won blue Senate seats, breaking Republican strongholds.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/kansas-governor-democrat-holscher-wins.html) reported that State Senator Cindy Holscher won the Kansas governor race, retaining the seat for Democrats.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQdFAyRnM5T3lHNFY3S0NUd3lKQkpuZGJSdmJMMGc5aVJZanZmb2JRNjFlU1laTHp0OXJwRzZUSnRmbVlPR1J5OHp1ZUNPbDBwNm5xOEZ3N1ZRejAxNk5hU1dyWFNJdTJsZk4zaW1rbHBnODZZUUdlR0tVR0NKSlNYdTFHZ2pmRHpobUkwUzNnSENSQzlIQXJvd05TV3QtQlFLX2R6a3RNQi1DYW8?oc=5) reported that Democrat Cindy Holscher was elected Kansas' next governor.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153171/up-first-newsletter-scott-colom-trump-democrats-ukraine-russia), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/12/mississippi-scott-colom-ukraine-donald-trump) reported that Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race after more than a week of counting ballots.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153171/up-first-newsletter-scott-colom-trump-democrats-ukraine-russia), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648747-trump-democrats-clash-corruption-probes/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that White House counsel Will Scharf warned Democrats that their probes into Trump could lead to executive branch investigations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPaTRFXzVMOVNIM2JnNFFkTzlrSmVYYnV5NTJlNDVVY1FhTXVBR1QybjdUd3JoVWpvZ3NRdFVGY0FkNlRmcW96d2VTR0tYei15dnp4eEhibFF4cGhwUnJnX3gwSHU0TEU4MUx2dE40V1BBSTZQYXVqOV9Nd0pkNXk0T3JQeFJ5emx3azFxMm5kLU5FLTJVcDJ5cmhURG9RYjBMVE1vbVJ6aEJiM3otQVFtVk5Cdw?oc=5), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/elections/mississippi-colom-senate-race-black-voters.html), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-mississippi-elects-democrat-colom-as-state-s-first-post-civil-war-black-senator), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-race-in-historic-upset-3725488) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race, becoming the state's first Black senator since the Reconstruction era or 1874.
[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-us-senate-seat-hyde-smith/) reported that Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith 49.2% to 48.7%.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mississippi-senate-race-democrat-scott-colom-defeats-republican-cindy-hyde-smith/a-79924938?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in the Mississippi Senate race.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mississippis-scott-colom-flips-us-senate-seat-democrat) reported that Scott Colom flipped a US Senate seat to the Democrats in Mississippi.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/mississippi-democrat-flips-us-senate-seat-historic-upset.1136956) reported that senator-elect Scott Colom waved during the conclusion of a victory rally at Tougaloo College.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/mississippi-elege-democrata-scott-colom-primeiro-senador-negro-pelo-estado-dos-eua-em-150-anos.shtml) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won a seat in the United States Senate for Mississippi, becoming the first Black politician to win the seat in 150 years.
[Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/11/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-01161555) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race in an upset.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cjy5x42p3qzko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Scott Colom’s victory makes him the first Black person elected to the US Senate from Mississippi in over 140 years.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/elections/hyde-smith-concedes-senate-colom.html) reported that Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith conceded the race to Scott Colom.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/elections/colom-mississippi-senate-democrats.html) reported that Colom’s victory gives Democrats 55 seats in the Senate.

[Politico](https://www.politico.com/video/2026/11/11/business-leaders-and-washington-prepare-for-a-democratic-congress-2227260) reported that business leaders and Washington are preparing for a Democratic Congress.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/democratic-dark-money-super-pac-complaint.html) reported that a new Democratic-tied dark-money group is drawing scrutiny over its midterm spending.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/blue-texas-battleground-kansas-both-parties-wonder-if-the-map-has-shifted.html) reported that the breadth of Democrats' midterm victories has led both parties to wonder if the electoral map has shifted, particularly regarding Texas.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/immigration-arrests-go-on-unabated-despite-trumps-misgivings-after-gops-midterm-wipeout/article71688665.ece) reported that Donald Trump said his immigration crackdown may have been too tough and suggested it was time for a change after Democrats won control of the next Congress.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/trump-ally-jim-jordan-elected-us-house-republican-leader-after-midterm-election-rout/article71688105.ece) reported that Ohio Congressman Jim Jordan was elected U.S. House Republican leader after the midterm election rout.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-senate-republicans-vote-to-keep-john-thune-as-leader-after-steep-midterm-election-losses/article71688101.ece) reported that U.S. Senate Republicans voted to keep John Thune as leader after steep midterm election losses.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/republican-house-leader-scalise-jordan.html) reported that House Republicans chose Jim Jordan as their leader and Senate Republicans re-elected John Thune following election losses.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/bernie-sanders-chuck-schumer-senate.html) reported that Bernie Sanders opposed Chuck Schumer as majority leader, with Sanders stating that the time for change is now ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/10/bernie-sanders-chuck-schumer-senate-democrats)).

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/video/2026/nov/10/chuck-schumer-confident-on-senate-leadership-role-bernie-sanders-video) reported that New York senator Chuck Schumer expressed confidence in becoming the majority leader after Democrats gained at least 54 seats in the Senate.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/ballot-measures-democrats-republicans.html) reported that in some states that elected Democrats, voters also approved measures to restrict transgender athletes, require voter identification, and toughen prison sentences.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tens-of-thousands-attend-polish-nationalist-march-days-afer-shootings) reported that tens of thousands of Polish nationalist sympathisers gathered in Warsaw for an annual Independence Day March.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/10/what-we-know-about-michal-oksinski-the-gunman-behind-the-krakow-mass-shooting) reported details regarding 24-year-old Michał Oksiński, who shot and killed his parents and sister before opening fire in central Kraków.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-shooting-artist-krakow-izabela-wozna-b3082508.html) reported that the suspect’s 21-year-old younger sister, a queer artist, was also killed in the Krakow shooting that left six dead.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/spoleczenstwo/art45472871-po-zamachu-w-krakowie-niemal-10-mln-zl-zebranych-dla-ofiar-i-policjantow) reported that over 7 million złoty has been raised for Artur Morański and Jakub Kulika, the police officers who immobilized the gunman in Krakow.

[Politika](https://www.politika.rs/scc/clanak/801608/zavrsena-obdukcija-napadaca-iz-krakova-utvrden-veci-broj-prostrelnih-rana) reported that autopsy results determined a large number of bullet wounds on the Krakow attacker.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/przestepczosc/art45472811-zamach-w-krakowie-specgrupa-wyjasni-ostrowiecki-watek-ataku) reported that a special group of officers will investigate the Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski thread of the Krakow attack and triple murder.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/poland-krakow-shooting-suspect-fascinated-by-norwegian-mass-murder-anders-breivik-says-justice-minister/a-79910435?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the 24-year-old suspect read significant material about Breivik and other far-right figures according to the justice minister.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPT3F0cG9XZEVlN0pBaEFzQTlWdjFka082QUE5eDRWd0RUMEpvQURHTG4zNHVpb0haZ1E4OVFiQmFXaHE2djVpVHhCcHRzSXp4cWF4cmRDcnotMXRlZ3UwNXR4NHprdWZBMDZnMXBTWUFYRnE2QXAwTjJwQXh5eUR3eTlrR3ZsTVNJZ1E?oc=5) reported that the Polish gunman who killed six people in Krakow square died in a hospital.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/krakow-poland-mass-shooting_n_6af16b78e4b043b6d4e34889) reported that the 24-year-old assailant who killed six and wounded 15 died in the hospital on Monday morning after being shot by police.

reports.text: [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038809/us-envoys-meet-putin-russia-ukraine-war-talks) NPR World reported that Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff went to the Kremlin to brief Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85102112) reported that Moscow's proposals for a new European security order include demands for NATO to refrain from stationing military bases and for independence referendums in Gagauzia and Transnistria if Moldova joins the EU.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/12/kushner-and-witkoff-hold-talks-with-putin-before-heading-to-meet-zelensky-as-europe-seeks-a-seat-at-the-peace-talks) reported that U.S. presidential envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff flew to Moscow and met with Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184334-kallas-kushner-finally-admits-europe-must-help-shape-outcome-of-ukraine-peace-talks.html) reported that Kaja Kallas stated Europe must have a say in the outcome of Ukraine peace talks.
[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640123/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-in-abu-dhabi-talks-report) reported that Russia demanded Finland leave NATO in Abu Dhabi talks.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217781) reported that the Kremlin stated there was no talk about NATO members' withdrawal from the alliance at the Abu Dhabi talks.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/eu-leaders-tussle-over-whom-to-send-to-ukraine-russia-peace-talks/a-79935468?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a seat at the table for Europe appears likely following comments by a US envoy who held talks with Putin, though who will take the seat remains unclear.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/12/8062612/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner at Casement Aerodrome near Dublin.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/6-killed-as-russia-ukraine-trade-accusations-after-abu-dhabi-talks-3725526) reported that Russia and Ukraine traded accusations over overnight airstrikes that killed at least six people following talks.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-big-development-in-peace-talks-as-ukraine-says-europe-to-join-russia-negotiations) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoy Jared Kushner stated that Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261113-eu-leaders-gather-in-dublin-as-ukraine-peace-talks-overshadow-ai-summit) reported that EU leaders gathered in Dublin on Friday for a summit dominated by efforts to secure Europe's place in negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.
[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-12/news-1S0Uk2fR5pm/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived at the Kremlin.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217341) reported that the meeting took place the day after the latest round of trilateral Russia-US-Ukraine talks concluded in Abu Dhabi.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/zelensky-warns-europe-over-us-russia-talks-on-broader-security-arrangements), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89954) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders at the European Political Community Summit in Dublin about US-Russia talks on security arrangements.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-russia-s-vladimir-putin-suggests-no-ukraine-compromise-in-meeting-with-us-envoys) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin indicated that the Kremlin would not compromise on its hardline demands to end the war in Ukraine during a meeting with US envoys.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/12/us-envoys-meet-putin-at-kremlin-after-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-envoys-meet-putin-at-kremlin-following-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi/article71694418.ece) reported that during talks with US envoys, Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Russia will target foreign troops in Ukraine and ruled out agreeing to foreign troops being stationed there.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261113-live-zelensky-and-kushner-confirm-that-europe-will-join-next-round-of-russia-ukraine-talks), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckn80j9jv3jxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/europe/russia-ukraine-witkoff-kushner.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed European leaders will join the next round of peace talks.

[RIA Novosti](https://ria.ru/20261112/putin-2131135070.html), [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/12/putin-predlozhil-organizovat-gumanitarnuiu-missiiu-iz-konstantinovki-i-nazval-gosgranitsu-edinstvennoi-liniei-razgranicheniia-s-ukrainoi-news) reported that Vladimir Putin proposed organizing a humanitarian mission from Kostiantynivka during his meeting in the Kremlin.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216967) reported that senior diplomat Sergey Ryabkov stated Russia clearly laid out its position at the Abu Dhabi talks and expects a response.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2216973) reported that Sergey Ryabkov addressed Europe's dejection, the Putin-Witkoff meeting, and Abu Dhabi outcomes.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-and-ukraine-trade-strikes-as-peace-talks-end-with-little-progress/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Russia and Ukraine were targeted by mutual attacks hours after concluding trilateral peace talks mediated by the United States.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/detalji-pregovora-u-abu-dhabiju-rusija-za-rat-u-ukrajini-okrivila-bidena-tvrde-da-im-nije-odgovorio-na-pismo/261112055) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff requested a new security agreement proposal with Europe from Russia.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1087349/rusija-krivi-bajdena-za-rat-tvrde-da-nije-odgovorio-na-putinovo-pismo) reported that Russia blamed Biden for the war during trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi, claiming he did not respond to Putin's letter.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/witkoff-and-kushner-arrive-in-moscow-seeking-putins-blessing-to-bring-europe-into-ukraine-) reported that Steve Witkoff is visiting Russia for the tenth time since Donald Trump's return to the White House, accompanied by Jared Kushner.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/us-envoys-arrive-in-moscow-for-russia-ukraine-talks-with-putin?traffic_source=rss) reported that the meeting with Kushner and Witkoff follows two days of trilateral talks in the UAE that yielded no breakthrough.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/us-envoys-arrive-in-moscow-for-latest-round-of-talks-with-putin-a94236) reported that this week's talks were the first direct talks between Russia and Ukraine mediated by the U.S. in nine months.
[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/russia-ukraine-trade-strikes-as-us-envoys-land-in-moscow) reported that Russia and Ukraine traded overnight strikes as the U.S. envoys arrived.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-prisoner-swap-trump-envoy-kushner-witkoff-b3083499.html) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to their biggest prisoner swap yet at the Abu Dhabi peace summit.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-envoys-jared-kushner-and-steve-witkoff-arrive-in-russia-for-latest-round-of-ukraine-peace-talks-with-vladimir-putin-101794470586213.html) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow for Ukraine peace talks with Putin, and will subsequently fly to Dublin to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/news-1RZjMaLSVR6/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Russia and Ukraine struck a major prisoner swap deal in Abu Dhabi.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/news-1RZga98dQA0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported a source in the Russian negotiating group stated that trilateral talks involving Russia, the United States and Ukraine ended in Abu Dhabi.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177706) reported that US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived at Vnukovo airport in Moscow to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/kremlin-aide-calls-abu-dhabi-ukraine-talks-substantive-3725471) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov described two days of US-mediated trilateral Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi as substantive and quite useful.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraine-reports-major-progress-in-russia-peace-talks) reported that Ukraine's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov stated negotiations with Russia yielded significant progress on security and economic prosperity.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/russia-and-ukraine-say-some-progress-made-talks-us-cites-lack-trust) reported that Russian and Ukrainian negotiators reported some progress in two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/russia-refused-to-discuss-ceasefire-or-territorial-issues-on-second-day-of-abu-dhabi-peace-talks-shifting-focus-to-european-security-architecture-rbc-ukraine-reports) reported that the Russian delegation refused to discuss territorial issues, a ceasefire, energy, or Black Sea security on the second day of talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/witkoff-and-kushner-arrive-in-moscow-for-talks-with-putin) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, arrived in Moscow on the morning of November 12.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/11/abu-dhabi-talks-end-with-prisoner-exchange-but-no-peace-breakthrough-a94227) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to carry out a major exchange of prisoners in the coming days despite persistent differences in negotiation positions.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/emisarios-trump-negocian-putin-moscu-otra-noche-misiles-drones_202611126af574ed9a31a65adcd94edd.html) reported that Moscow launched multiple ballistic missiles and 123 long-range drones against Kyiv and other areas of Ukraine.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/israels-new-knesset-sworn-in-as-eisenkot-seeks-to-form-government/000001a1-c600-d0f7-adfb-f721e5770000) reported that Israel's new Knesset was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot seeks to form a government, while President Herzog urged lawmakers to compromise.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/who-matan-kahana-israels-proposed-new-knesset-speaker) reported that anti-Netanyahu bloc leaders agreed to nominate Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/arab-party-to-back-eisenkot-blocs-bid-to-replace-knesset-speaker/000001a1-c553-dba2-a9f9-d57fa5ce0000) reported that Arab-led Joint List lawmaker Ahmad Tibi said his party would back the Eisenkot bloc's Knesset speaker nominee.

[New York Times World](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/middleeast/israel-parliament-eisenkot.html) reported that dozens of first-time lawmakers headed to the Knesset, where the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot has a majority.

[BBC World](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crd939lpzjp9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, had the first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/gadi-eisenkot-netanyahu-allies-form-israel-government) reported that former military chief Gadi Eisenkot reached out to Netanyahu allies as he strived to form a government.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/07/israel-president-gadi-eisenkot-form-government) reported that Israel's president chose Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a government after the Knesset had been deadlocked.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043517/new-israel-parliament-to-be-sworn-in-as-gadi-eisenkot-seeks-government) reported that Israel's new parliament was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu loses his majority.

According to [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-former-israeli-prime-minister-barak-urges-eisenkot-to-accelerate-government-formation/), former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government.

The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog warned against the continuation of certain policies during a ceremony to officially task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government ([Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323654-herzog-tells-eisenkot-to-continue-negotiations-with-lebanon)).

Middle East Monitor reported that members of Israel's Shas party are considering supporting an Eisenkot-led government if United Torah Judaism joins ([Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-shas-reportedly-open-to-supporting-eizenkot-led-government-if-united-torah-judaism-joins/)).

reports.text: [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/respiratory-illnesses-rise-gaza-worst-come-winter-floods-arrive-who-says), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1113/1599114-israel-gaza/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581076/who-warns-respiratory-infections-surge-in-gaza-as-winter-approaches/) reported that the World Health Organization warned of surging respiratory illnesses in Gaza as winter floods arrive.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217837) reported that the Board of Peace urged immediate action on Donald Trump's Gaza plan following a hospital strike.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israeli-strike-on-vehicle-outside-wedding-hall-kills-one-palestinian-in-central-gaza/) reported that an Israeli strike on a vehicle outside a wedding hall killed one person in Deir al-Balah.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/53-nations-demand-urgent-aid-access-as-gaza-baby-freezes-to-death) reported that 53 countries and organizations urged Israel to allow unrestricted humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip as a nine-month-old baby froze to death.
[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/13/mundo/028n1mun?partner=rss) reported that the Israeli army attacked Nasser hospital for the seventh time, killing at least seven Palestinians.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-hamas-says-board-of-peace-adopts-misleading-israeli-narrative-on-gaza-hospitals/) reported that Hamas strongly rejected the Board of Peace's adoption of what it called a misleading Israeli narrative regarding the use of Gaza hospitals for military command.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202897/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%B6%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%81%D9%89-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported that the Peace Council in Gaza stated that the human casualties from the Israeli strike on Nasser hospital in Khan Younis confirm the need to implement Trump's peace plan immediately.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190048/11-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86) reported that 10 citizens were martyred in Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip, including six who died in a strike targeting Nasser Complex.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-strikes-gaza-hospital-says-hamas-senior-figure-inside/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Israel stated Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190087/%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%88%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A1%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88) reported that the 'Himaya' human rights center condemned the targeting of the surgical department at Nasser Medical Complex as a war crime.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/12/israeli-airstrike-nasser-hospital-gaza-kills-surgeon) reported that an Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza killed a surgeon and five others, including patients awaiting surgery.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-targets-senior-hamas-member-in-gaza-hospital-strike/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/israel-afirma-que-objetivo-bombardeo-hospital-era-comandante-hamas_202611126af597d74196933d7eda7a4c.html) reported that Israel stated the target of its strike on a hospital was a Hamas commander named Muhamad abu Ismail.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190073/%D9%86%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1) reported that Hamas political bureau member Basem Naim held Israel and the Peace Council responsible for targeting the Nasser Medical Complex.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israeli-strike-on-gazas-nasser-hospital-kills-6-including-doctor) reported that an Israeli airstrike on southern Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed at least six people, including a surgeon, according to Palestinian health authorities.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261112-6-palestinians-killed-dozens-injured-in-israeli-strike-on-nasser-medical-complex-in-khan-younis/) reported that six Palestinians were killed and dozens injured in an Israeli airstrike on a building inside the Nasser Medical Complex in western Khan Younis.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580370/israeli-airstrike-kills-six-people-at-nasser-hospital-in-southern-gaza/) reported that an Israeli airstrike killed six people and wounded around 20 others at Nasser Hospital, according to Gaza's civil defence agency.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/world/middleeast/nasser-hospital-gaza-strike-israel.html) reported that an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed at least 6 people and injured 20.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-12/deadly-israeli-air-strike-nasser-hospital-gaza/107379926) reported that Palestinian health authorities stated an Israeli air strike on Nasser Hospital killed at least six people and injured 20.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckzd9p7e4eqeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Gaza civil defence agency stated an Israeli strike hit the surgery department of Nasser Hospital, injuring at least 20 people.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190062/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%83%D8%A8-793-%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF-17) reported that Gaza's government media office stated Israel and the US bear full responsibility for attacks on medical facilities, including 793 attacks on the health sector.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190058/%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-) reported that Palestinian factions condemned the Israeli bombing of the surgical building at Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Yunis.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israeli-strike-southern-gaza-hospital-kills-six-gaza-civil-defence-says) reported that an Israeli airstrike on a building at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed at least six people and wounded 20 others.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190015/%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%82%D9%88%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that 398 Israeli settlers entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque courtyards and performed Talmudic rituals.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190012/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%88-%D9%8A%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B2%D8%B1%D9%87-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine stated Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ignored the Peace Board statement and continued massacres in Gaza.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-crime/2026-11-11/ty-article/.premium/israel-neglecting-deteriorating-health-of-jailed-gaza-doctor-rights-group-says/000001a1-c992-dc22-abe1-f9f61bf10000) reported that a medical report on detained Gaza hospital director Hussam Abu Safiya points to significant weight loss and blood test abnormalities that were not investigated.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/trumps-board-of-peace-chides-israel-for-insufficient-response-to-gaza-flooding/) reported that US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace urged Israel to allow essential aid into Gaza after calling its response to weekend flooding insufficient.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-11/UN-steps-up-Gaza-aid-efforts-as-heavy-rains-affect-over-200-000-people-1RYEZNp8Cly/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that UN humanitarians stated they and partners are scrambling to aid more than 200,000 residents of Gaza affected by heavy rains.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/unicef-says-israel-blocks-gaza-basin-repairs-warns-floods) reported that UNICEF stated Israel is blocking repairs to Gaza's water basins, including the Sheikh Radwan stormwater basin in Gaza City, which is contaminated and at risk of overflowing.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/middleeast/gaza-flooding-israel.html) reported that at least four people from one family were killed and thousands of Palestinians lost their shelters when a storm battered overcrowded tent camps.

[The Telegraph](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/terror-and-security/gaza-floods-humanitarian-emergency-trump-board-of-peace/) reported that Gaza floods were warned to be an immediate humanitarian emergency by Trump's Board of Peace.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/israeli-attacks-kill-at-least-six-in-gaza-including-father-and-son?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel has killed more than 1,600 people in Gaza since last year's ceasefire according to the enclave's Health Ministry, and that a father and child were among six Palestinians killed in recent attacks.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168766) reported that an infant drowned and five Gazans were killed when a sand dune collapsed on their tents as the first heavy rains swept the area.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/unicef-heavy-rainfall-affects-more-than-106000-people-in-gaza/) reported that UNICEF stated recent heavy rainfall in the Gaza Strip affected more than 106,000 people and damaged shelters.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/unicef-says-israel-blocks-gaza-basin-repairs-warns-flood-risk) reported that UNICEF stated Israel rejected the importation of equipment needed to repair a water basin in Gaza.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261110-un-rapporteur-albanese-calls-plight-of-gaza-children-in-flooded-tents-disgrace-of-our-era/) reported that UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese described the conditions facing Palestinian children in rain-flooded tents as the disgrace of our era.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/09/four-killed-in-sand-embankment-collapse-in-gaza-video) reported that a sand embankment collapsed onto tents due to torrential rain in Gaza, killing a woman and three small children.

Felesteen reported that Hamas stated the authorities continue to manage and deepen the humanitarian crisis in Gaza through the blockade and war impacts ([Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189873/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84)).

The National reported on a deadly landslide and warned about winter conditions in Gaza ([The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/09/people-were-screaming-deadly-tent-collapse-a-warning-for-winter-in-gaza/)).

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took just 30 percent of the votes in local elections, marking its worst electoral performance to date.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-10-from-475-to-325-the-ancs-local-government-slide-in-one-chart/) reported that the ANC's share of the local vote fell from 47.5% to 32.5%, while the MK entered at 9.9% and the DA rose to 22.9%.

[The Star (South Africa)](https://iol.co.za/the-star/news/2026-11-10-seven-new-parties-set-to-shake-up-cape-town-council-after-local-government-elections/) reported that newly elected municipal councils have 14 days to hold their first meetings and elect political leaders, while 127 hung councils face coalition negotiations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took 30.76 percent of votes in municipal elections, marking its worst-ever result.

[France 24 Africa](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/eye-on-africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-suffers-a-historic-setback-in-local-elections-as-coalition-talks-begin) reported that South Africa's ruling ANC party secured just 30 percent of the vote in local elections, marking its worst-ever result as coalition talks began.

According to [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/south-africa/2026-11-08-iec-declares-2026-local-elections-free-and-fair-as-sa-enters-coalition-era/), the Electoral Commission of South Africa declared the 2026 local elections free and fair while ordering recounts in five wards.

reports.text: [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/asia/reuters-revela-una-tercera-relacion-extramarital-de-jensen-huang-fundador-de-nvidia-presuntamente-con-otra-empleada-de-la-compania-esto-se-sabe-3600651), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/IA/jensen-huang-el-exceo-de-nvidia-tuvo-un-amorio-con-una-segunda-empleada-de-la-empresa-segun-reuters-nid13112026/) reported that Reuters revealed a third extramarital relationship involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang with another company employee.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640125/us-senate-banking-committee-chair-calls-on-jensen-huang-lutnick-to-testify), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1113/1599069-nvidia-us/) reported that the US Senate Banking Committee chair called on Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify following Huang's resignation.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/13/quem-pode-suceder-jensen-huang-na-nvidia-com-renuncia-do-ceo-veja-nomes-cotados-para-assumir-a-gigante-dos-chips-apos-comando-interino.ghtml) reported that Colette Kress and others were cited as potential successors to Jensen Huang at Nvidia.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmq5vd1wdgz6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) BBC World reported that ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was summoned to testify before Congress about an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-914815) reported that three Israeli tech leaders are among those being considered to succeed Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/politics/lutnick-nvidia-commerce-china-chips.html) reported that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his department have shielded Nvidia as concerns grew over A.I. chip sales.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-potential-national-security-crisis-as-nvidia-ex-ceo-summoned-by-us-congress) reported that the investigation into former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is turning into a potential national security crisis.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-lawmakers-summon-nvidia-ex-ceo-after-affair-with-suspected-spy/) reported that US lawmakers summoned Jensen Huang to face questions in December following his resignation.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-13/congress-demands-answers-over-nvidia-espionage-allegations-and-jensen-huang-scandal.html) reported that Democratic lawmakers called for an explanation regarding the former CEO's close ties with Donald Trump over Nvidia espionage allegations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/white-house-reportedly-discussing-howard-lutnick-s-future-as-commerce-secretary) reported that senior White House officials are discussing whether Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick should be pushed out following the spy scandal involving Nvidia.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-replacement) reported that Colette Kress will take over as interim Nvidia CEO on a short-term basis.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914772) reported that sources stated former CEO Jensen Huang conducted an extramarital affair with a second Nvidia employee.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nvidias-boss-resigns-over-multiple-affairs-20261113-p61du9.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang resigned in the wake of multiple affairs, including with a suspected Chinese spy.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/ex-nvidia-ceo-huang-and-us-commerce-secretary-howard-lutnick-summoned-to-testify-before-co), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/13/nvidia-l-ancien-pdg-de-nvidia-et-le-secretaire-au-commerce-invites-a-temoigner-au-senat-americain_6809295_3210.html) reported that former Nvidia CEO Huang and US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick were invited to testify before the US Senate.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/nvidias-huang-lutnick-summoned-to-testify-to-us-senate?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Senate Banking Committee stated the former tech CEO and commerce secretary could face legal action if they fail to appear.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/white-house-reportedly-discussing-howard-lutnick-s-future-as-commerce-secretary), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-commerce-secretary-howard-lutnick-nvidia-b3084187.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/white-house-weighs-ousting-howard-lutnick-as-commerce-secretary-amid-nvidia-controversy-report-101794525840437.html) reported that White House officials are discussing Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's future following the Nvidia controversy.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-senate-asks-huang-lutnick-to-testify-on-nvidia/a-79936707?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott asked Howard Lutnick and Jensen Huang to testify.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/european-shares-fall-as-nvidia-ceos-exit-raises-doubts-over-ai-boom) reported that European shares fell as Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia raised doubts over the AI boom.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936449) reported that Jensen Huang's resignation could give South Korean HBM makers greater leverage in supply negotiations.

[El País](https://elpais.com/economia/2026-11-13/el-congreso-inicia-el-escrutinio-por-el-caso-del-espionaje-en-nvidia-y-el-escandalo-de-las-infidelidades-de-jensen-huang.html) reported that Democratic legislators asked for explanations regarding the former CEO's closeness to Donald Trump.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/supuesta-espia-caso-nvidia-compro-chips-prohibidos-que-acabaron-china_202611136af6dafd03bbf30bb04ac1fe.html) reported according to Bloomberg that servers with Nvidia H800 chips were sold to Aperia Cloud Services in Singapore before ending up with a Sugon subsidiary in China.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/jensen-huang-declarara-ante-el-congreso-sobre-riesgos-para-la-seguridad-nacional-legisladores-exigiran-respuestas-a-exceo-de-nvidia/) reported that Senator John Thune and other lawmakers consider it necessary to investigate Jensen Huang's apparent implication with a Chinese intelligence agent, and that Huang will testify before Congress.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/asia/reuters-revela-una-tercera-relacion-extramarital-de-jensen-huang-fundador-de-nvidia-presuntamente-con-otra-empleada-de-la-compania-esto-se-sabe-3600651) reported that a third extramarital relationship involving Jensen Huang with another company employee was revealed.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-dice-que-huang-esta-pasando-por-un-infierno-tras-salida-de-nvidia-dice-que-es-un-hombre-extraordinario/) reported that Donald Trump stated Jensen Huang is going through hell following his exit from Nvidia and mentioned Tim Cook as a possible substitute.
[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/i-am-a-piece-of-sh-jensen-huangs-last-hours-as-nvidia-ceo-101794536356535.html) reported on details of Jensen Huang's tenure as Nvidia CEO.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/world/jensen-huang-nvidia-last-hours/), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/from-i-m-piece-of-sh-to-wife-being-main-concern-5-big-details-from-jensen-huang-last-days-as-nvidia-ceo-101794542783924.html) reported that Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after controversy over alleged extramarital affairs.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353534/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-steps-down-in-big-blow-to-ai-boom), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-in-blow-to-ai-boom-he-helped-foster/) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down from his position.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/economie/article/2026/11/12/alice-huang-l-insaisissable-intermediaire-de-l-ombre-a-l-origine-de-la-chute-de-jensen-huang-le-patron-de-nvidia_6809128_3234.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/la-perte-de-jensen-huang-est-un-veritable-coup-dur-la-chute-du-patron-de-nvidia-provoque-un-seisme-sur-la-planete-ia-20261112) reported in French outlets on the departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and intermediary Alice Huang.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/ousted-nvidia-ceo-huang-reportedly-had-relationship-with-2nd-employee), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/former-nvidia-ceo-huang-had-a-relationship-with-a-second-employee-sources-say/article71696426.ece) reported that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a second employee, Kimberly Powell.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOUkxOYXBCUHFaN0RTbHNZLUcwVG02UmtKQWJwLWc0X0lfQUdpVjl4UjhncWktZTU3YmF0SjdtbnBRSk04RHAtSTQ0QW9CelRNeU9HUG5EdU9ROWJTUnpHSFMzMWlCSzhvXzVlRVFZVmR0dDFjYk1IRnZSQnVOTXZHUjJybkpGbzR4STNfSDAwMUEyZ3FkaGV6bXBpa1k4RVk?oc=5), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-nvidia-huang-replacement-tim-cook-b3084032.html), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/trump-wants-apples-cook-to-replace-huang-as-nvidia-ceo) reported that Donald Trump suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-doj-has-yet-to-determine-whether-alice-huang-is-a-chinese-spy-official-3725539) reported that Attorney General Todd Blanche stated the US Justice Department has not reached a conclusion on whether Alice Huang has ties to Chinese intelligence.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/nvidia-jensen-huang-tim-cook-trump-b3084385.html) reported that wealth manager Ross Gerber dismissed Tim Cook as a potential replacement for Jensen Huang and suggested an internal appointment.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrats-demand-answers-on-trumps-nvidia-ties-after-jensen-huangs-exit-americans-deserve-to-know-101794563838595.html) reported that senior Democrats called for congressional scrutiny of Nvidia and the Trump administration following Huang's resignation.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/some-nvidia-employees-want-jensen-huang-back-as-ceo-believe-everyone-makes-mistakes-report-101794555177936.html) reported that an Nvidia engineer submitted an internal suggestion box post asking the board to consider employee sentiment for Huang's return.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/3-indian-origin-ceos-sanjay-mehrotra-nikesh-arora-thomas-kurian-in-race-as-jensen-huang-quits-top-nvidia-post-101794555160365.html) reported that the Nvidia board remains open to insider and outsider candidates as it looks for a permanent chief to replace Jensen Huang.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-quits-nvidia-as-scandal-rocks-ai-giant/) reported that Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of Nvidia following revelations of two extramarital affairs.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261113008400320) reported that Nvidia confirmed its planned supply of GPUs to South Korea despite Jensen Huang's resignation, according to the science minister.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5PcHBlLVR0enhHcTZRdlRIYllGN3ZNc2ZSTXhTNkIyck5rbmRTNC0zNXdTaWdKeHdVUFAybk8xZV9zR2I1cl9rcmpLSmRMOFp2Rk1IYnhXMmRnbkVPODhPR0JoQ2poc1dYaGdZ?oc=5), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/jensen-huang-spy-row-affairs-leave-nvidia-without-its-rockstar-ceo/a-79926972?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261112-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-after-mounting-scandals) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is stepping down from his position.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQOUJpQ1liNWFtSE1mbDNEelBsWnRaUG1kM1doMGlIR2I4MEpKcXVsb2JpYWlVU2JUSkc5Y2tvUjBQdC1OTzB4Ny1pZ29oell4RXZ0dHlfVHhaR3JScFhIckx6VkxaQ0xMU2pubmg1SG9PV3F1Y1JkUDNOTkdSMEtoaHB2REFWelRxOExGaFBJSVhnNzUwRWFtVA?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-replacement) reported that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/12/nvidia-supply-chain-asia/) reported that Nvidia's Asian supply chain is preparing for life after Huang as the board meets to decide his future.

reports.text: [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/asia-pacific/politics/prabowo-consolidates-power/) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government since taking office.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/) reported that the controversy is connected to a widening rift between President Prabowo Subianto and his predecessor Joko Widodo.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1XcTVMMmRlWnlGcXJzVUFKUDRpX0FqTmc3RjFhd2RuUGJOdTFpM2g5dVc0YmlMZUtoWGcxQUdlVU5DdThKWjkxS3ppWW1MM0o4SGNMZlpoWDVqTUlkc29VZkJDdTVTZElJV043RlpsNHNKaENHX2xZRDNZdWU?oc=5), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153190/indonesias-vp-resigns-as-his-eligibility-and-academic-credentials-are-questioned), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/indonesia-vice-president-diploma-resignation-explained) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned following questions regarding his academic credentials and eligibility.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-jokowi-prabowo-6541991) reported that analysts stated Gibran's exit as Indonesia's vice president could let President Prabowo further consolidate his influence.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.
[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374034/indonesian-vp-resignation-drama-raises-stakes-prabowo-alliances-strain) reported that the prospect of Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepping down as Indonesia's vice-president has raised the stakes for President Prabowo Subianto.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441607/palace-respects-parliament-inquiry-push-into-vps-diploma) reported that the Indonesian Presidential Palace stated it respects the parliamentary political process concerning an inquiry into the Vice President's diploma.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441583/palace-confirms-gibrans-intention-to-resign-from-vice-presidency) reported that State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi confirmed Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed his intention to resign from the vice presidency.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3373961/indonesian-vp-gibrans-fate-hangs-balance-parliament-ponders-probe) reported that Indonesia's parliament reconvened with lawmakers weighing a probe into the eligibility of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/asia-pacific/politics/indonesia-vice-president-probe/) reported that the fate of Indonesia's vice president hangs in the balance as lawmakers mull a probe amid a political rift between his father and President Prabowo Subianto.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/us-terror-case-raf-fairford-arrests) reported that a suspect held in a New York jail has been linked to a handler behind Iran-linked operations in Britain in connection with the RAF Fairford arrests.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/3-iranian-backed-men-indicted-in-attempted-plot-on-raf-fairford/) reported that three men, with one working from jail, allegedly conspired to commit around 20 terrorist attacks across the US and Europe, including a plot on RAF Fairford.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914783) reported that a 41-year-old US Army officer stationed at NATO headquarters in the UK was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579836/us-authorities-charge-three-men-over-suspected-terror-plot-targeting-raf-fairford/) reported that United States authorities unsealed an eight-count indictment charging three men for involvement in foreign terror plots targeting RAF Fairford.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/coded-messages-from-jail-cell-how-alleged-iranian-operative-mohammad-dawood-al-saadi-coordinated-foiled-raf-fairford-terror-plot-uk-us-iran-war-101794386640896.html) reported that American and British authorities suspected an Iranian link to the foiled terror plot, while Tehran denied any involvement.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-charges-3-alleged-iran-operatives-for-targeting-raf-fairford-in-uk-20-other-terror-plots-101794384900293.html) reported that US prosecutors charged three alleged operatives for targeting RAF Fairford in the UK and other terror plots.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/us-charges-three-men-for-allegedly-plotting-attack-on-uk-base?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US charged three men for allegedly plotting an attack on a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, UK.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-charges-3-alleged-iranian-operatives-over-plots-targeting-jewish-communities-and-a-uk-airbase/a-79913543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US prosecutors claimed three alleged Iranian operatives were planning a campaign of terror against Jewish communities and a UK airbase.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

reports.text: [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

[Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.
