previous_titles: Major Microsoft outage disrupts Teams and Outlook as thousands of users affected
Global Microsoft outage knocks out Outlook and other services
Microsoft Outage Hits Outlook, Teams Worldwide, Draws 130,000 US Reports

reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/microsoft-outage-today-latest-outlook-teams-down-openai-fixed-b3084265.html) reported that Microsoft stated attempts to fix the outage affecting Outlook and Teams were not going as expected.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/first-thing-global-microsoft-outage-chaos-signs-of-stabilisation) reported that users of Microsoft Teams and Outlook in businesses and public services reported problems, while the tech firm noted signs of stabilisation.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/portugal-government-schools-and-health-services-hit-by-global-microsoft-outage) reported that a global Microsoft outage disrupted sectors in Portugal, hindering access to Outlook and Teams.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-descarta-ciberataque-tras-caida-mundial-de-outlook-atribuye-paron-a-una-carga-elevada-en-su-infraestructura/), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/caida-mundial-de-outlook-microsoft-descarta-un-ciberataque) reported that Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack after a global Outlook outage and attributed the stoppage to high load.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/tecnologia/problemas-con-outlook-hoy-reportan-una-falla-a-nivel-mundial-y-sigue-sin-funcionar-el-correo-de-nid13112026/) La Nación reported that a general service drop affected Microsoft 365, including Outlook email, OneDrive online storage, and the office package.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/13/microsoft-outlook-outage-update/) The National reported that Microsoft is continuing to work on the Outlook email problem with partial recovery seen in some regions.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2217845) reported that Microsoft announced gradual traffic recovery after a server failure.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/technology/2026-11-13/microsoft-fails-to-restore-services-after-more-than-12-hours-of-global-disruption.html) reported that an executive stated a cyberattack is unlikely to be behind the global Microsoft disruptions affecting email, AI, and other applications.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-disrupts-global-financial-markets-and-trading-desks-forces-traders-to-use-phones-101794556388573.html) reported that the Microsoft outage disrupted financial markets and trading desks, forcing traders to use phones and WhatsApp.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/microsoft-outage-disrupts-uk-health-services-delays-patient-referrals/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a union warned the Microsoft outage impacted Britain's National Health Service by delaying patient referrals and prescriptions.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/microsoft-outage-disrupts-colorado-jail-bond-payments-delays-release-of-prisoners-101794562136835.html) reported that a global Microsoft service disruption affected online bond payments at the Arapahoe County Detention Facility in Colorado.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2217693) reported that Charles Lamanna stated the widespread Microsoft services outage was not caused by a cyberattack.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major outage disrupted email, workplace communications and business operations worldwide, drawing 130,000 US reports.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/en-direct-panne-mondiale-de-microsoft-et-d-outlook-les-difficultes-se-poursuivent-de-lourdes-consequences-rapportees-dans-le-monde-20261113) reported that Microsoft mentioned progressive improvements for some customers while noting ongoing difficulties.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2026/1112/1599052-microsoft/), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/microsoft-reports-connectivity-disruptions-affecting-multiple-regions-worldwide/) reported that thousands of Microsoft users worldwide experienced service disruptions and connectivity issues across multiple regions.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/pixels/article/2026/11/13/une-panne-mondiale-d-outlook-empeche-des-dizaines-de-milliers-d-utilisateurs-d-acceder-a-leurs-e-mails_6809171_4408996.html) reported that Microsoft stated there was no sign of malicious action or cyberattack during the worldwide Outlook messaging outage.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/entreprises-paralysees-examens-perturbes-avions-retardes-la-panne-mondiale-de-microsoft-et-outlook-provoque-des-consequences-en-cascade-20261113) reported that the Microsoft and Outlook outage caused cascading disruptions including paralyzed businesses, delayed exams, and delayed flights.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-914812) reported that experts ruled out a cyberattack and explained the disruption as a suspected server failure.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPQWpWeUZnbllhcFk4WktZS0s3T1N6T3k3Vnhhd3pfSE9SWF9iRmRIQUljdHZXN0UtWS1uZS1rbUNZSlVPd1NXLXRtVUVtc3NQNTgxMVFMWjVnT3pPb09EX1g1YUx3WkF2VHk0bUMwWlhkRHdpT0JFRE5SQ3pQRkdmSnpUOHNXLUo1dXNSY3lFdkpSdU5laDdwSlhWRDVnNjBFcUh2Y0FwMXNldE8tSFpPaw?oc=5), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/13/microsoft-outlook-outage-update/) reported that a Microsoft outage spilled into Asia-Pacific business hours with a partial recovery seen in some regions.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/solucionado-caida-microsoft-outlook-teams-siguen-funcionar-hoy-ia-claude-sufre-graves-errores-inicio-sesion_0_WJwBFsZGfY.html) reported that the Claude AI platform experienced login errors during the Microsoft disruption.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-se-cae-a-nivel-mundial-outlook-y-teams-estan-afectados-33100651) reported that Microsoft stated the global service outage is due to a high load in its infrastructure across several regions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/outlook-suma-mas-de-5-horas-sin-funcionar-persiste-caida-del-servicio-de-microsoft/) reported that Downdetector monitors showed about 130,000 users reported problems with Outlook.

[El País](https://elpais.com/tecnologia/2026-11-13/microsoft-no-logra-recuperar-sus-servicios-tras-una-caida-global-de-mas-de-12-horas.html) reported that a company executive discarded any cyberattack behind the failures affecting Outlook, Teams, and AI platforms.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/microsoft-rules-out-malicious-activity-as-cause-for-global-outage/a-79935611?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-microsoft-faces-a-major-outlook-outage-no-signs-of-a-cyberattack) reported that Microsoft ruled out malicious activity as the cause of the global outage.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/microsoft-battling-global-outlook-microsoft-365-outage), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that the disruption hit Microsoft products in 74 countries and territories.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that repair efforts were not going as expected and the firm was seeking alternative solutions.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that problems with Outlook reached a climax of at least 140,000 users by 18:00 GMT on Thursday according to Downdetector.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-914798) reported that Microsoft struggled to restore Outlook, Teams, and Copilot after a widespread outage disrupted government agencies across the US and the Asia-Pacific.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/13/hse-emails-affected-as-global-microsoft-outage-hits-ireland/) reported that HSE emails were affected in Ireland as the global Microsoft outage hit.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outage-live-updates-november-13-2026-steps-to-fix-outlook-and-other-apps-ongoing/article71696624.ece) reported that the Microsoft outage entered its second day and the company stated it was not aware of malicious activity.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-says-not-aware-of-any-malicious-activity-causing-outlook-outage/) reported that Microsoft stated it was not aware of any malicious activity behind the hours-long disruption of its Outlook services.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE1yMVY4dHAzNUlQOGpDMkdrSlpFbEM4Y1AwdGdYcm1JM1A4QTZsUzZ3WFl0U1FVN2JRbFdlUXFfWl92TlpocWxOeDhkMTIxXy05ZlhiZkJMdld3Tl93bXBjWEUxR0c4TE0?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-working-on-alternate-workstreams-as-outage-fix-fails-to-deliver-expected-results-101794541815694.html) reported that Microsoft stated planned fixes for its global outage are not working as expected.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-live-updates-microsoft-365-teams-outlook-copilot-users-report-problems-today-13-nov-2026-101794548104316.html) reported that the global outage disrupted Outlook and Teams across the US and Asia-Pacific.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-and-copilot-disrupting-thousands), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261113-major-microsoft-outlook-outage-disrupts-services-in-74-countries), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/microsoft-works-to-restore-outlook-and-teams-after-global-outage/a-79935611?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a global Microsoft outage disrupted Outlook and Teams services across numerous countries.
